attacks.name: Claw Slash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change one of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Savage Predator
steps: |!wild| |!hit| |*Finisher|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a |*Claw Slash| attack. This character may reroll any number of attack dice during that attack.

superPowers.name: No Mercy
superPowers.body: During the next attack this character makes this Turn, add 1 die to its attack roll for each |!damage| the target character has, to a maximum of 3.

superPowers.name: Untamed Force
superPowers.body: After an attack against this character is resolved, it may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 2, this character may make a |*Claw Slash| attack targeting it. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Aggressive
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it may Advance Toward the attacker |!range_small|.
